author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Bento box in the reference layout: a tall left rice compartment with an umeboshi dot, broccoli florets heaped over the top-right edge, and rice balls forming the lower-right compartment; the current drawing was an empty three-door box with knob dots and read as a cabinet.
omissions: The reference's small egg arc in the left compartment is shown as a single plum dot (an arc cannot keep 8 from both walls of an 18-wide compartment); the third rice ball is merged into two.
